pretreatments.description: Dilute citric acid pretreatment of sugarcane bagasse (Conditions: Temperature (T), reaction time (t), Percentage by weight of citric acid (PCA); Range T: 120-180 °C, t: 20-90 min, PCA: 3-12 wt%) - This pretreatment step alters the chemical composition, increases accessibility of cellulose, and reduces hemicellulose and lignin content prior to enzymatic hydrolysis and biogas production.
